title: Delivery Doctor
eyebrow: Agent telemetry transport verifier, solo build
sub: Your agent sent the event. Your dashboard never got it. This names the hop it died at.

bullets.text: Named the exact hop where agent telemetry dies in transit across 9 reproduced failure modes, from buffer drops and expired keys to 429s and queue overflows: replayed tagged canary events through the SDK and read each one back from intake.
Turned client-side diagnosis into a lookup, not a guess: a delivery ledger recording every event state change, lined up against the server's intake log. Zero runtime dependencies, one local command.
